claim: Unicorn Factory Lisboa announced the winners of its 2026 Entrepreneurship Awards on 27 October at the Técnico Innovation Center.
The Unicorn Factory Lisboa awards announcement took place on the organisation's fourth anniversary.
Three of the seven Unicorn Factory Lisboa 2026 winners build with AI.
Algarve Evolution aims to support 500 companies, help create 150 startups and reach 50,000 people across the Algarve by 2032.
Algarve Evolution is based in Faro and began in 2018 as a group of local entrepreneurs.
An Informa D&B study presented in November 2025 counted 115 startups in the Algarve in 2024, 78% of them in information technology and communications.
Algarve startups' turnover grew 29% a year from 2021 to 2024, against 24.2% a year for startups nationally.
Algarve Evolution's Founder2Founder programme launched in October 2026, choosing eight companies from 41 applications.
